violation_type.title: Written Activity Plans - Followed by Caregivers (26 TAC §744.2005(b)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plans - Followed by Caregivers
violation_type.typical_finding: The original activity plan that was posted was from February 2022. The activity plan was replaced with the current activity plan, however, staff did not follow the plan that was outlined for the day.

finding_variants.text: The original activity plan that was posted was from February 2022. The activity plan was replaced with the current activity plan, however, staff did not follow the plan that was outlined for the day.
The activity plan was reviewed during this inspection and it was determined grades 3-5 were not following the schedule.
